ramp.com is a credit card/expense platform that surely loses money right now... pretty heavy/slow javascript but pretty functional nonetheless...

It's what we use for tracking expenses and getting comped for travel, meals, software licenses etc - works great in my experience. I can click a few buttons and get a new business expense card spun up in less than a minute, use it to make a purchase, get approval and have the funds transferred. Boom easy.

Ramp does seem to have a genuinely good product, but every time I interact with anyone who works on it, I'm struck by how much they want to talk about how hardcore and advanced their working style is.
They make corporate expense software but they LARP like they're on the bleeding edge of tech. My guy you make a slightly nicer Concur.
